title: Summary-review contract: a summary-list rendering per step with Change links returning to each step and retaining every other answer on save
description: After every step is Completed (per REQ-001) the wizard renders a summary-review surface: one summary-list section per step, each row a definition-list entry naming the field label and the operator's answer, and a Change link per row that navigates to the step with the field focused. Editing on the target step and saving returns to the summary-review surface with every other answer retained; only the edited answer is updated. The summary-list shape follows the GOV.UK Design System summary-list pattern. Per WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.4 Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data): the summary-review is the last checkpoint before submission and every answer is reversible up to submit.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec section 5.3, REQ 4.
